blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 學完本節後，你將能夠：
blocks.en: After completing this section, you will be able to:

blocks.zh: 說明氦氣測試、OES、空氣超音波及X射線偵測的工作原理。
blocks.en: Explain how helium testing, OES, airborne ultrasound and X-ray detection work.

blocks.zh: 辨別哪種包裝類型最適合各項創新方法。
blocks.en: Identify which package types are best suited to each innovative method.

blocks.zh: 比較四種方法的洩漏偵測極限（LOD）。
blocks.en: Compare the leak detection limits (LOD) of the four methods.

blocks.zh: 了解各方法在製藥生產中的主要限制與挑戰。
blocks.en: Understand the main limitations and challenges of each method in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 針對SUS袋、瓶、注射器及軟包裝，套用正確的方法選擇邏輯。
blocks.en: Apply the correct method-selection logic for single-use systems (SUS) bags, vials, syringes and flexible packaging.

blocks.zh: 理解各方法在CDMO驗證策略中的考量。
blocks.en: Understand how each method fits into a CDMO validation strategy.

blocks.zh: 創新測試方法概述 | p26
blocks.en: Overview of Innovative Test Methods | p26

blocks.zh: 中文解說 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 本節四大創新方法
blocks.en: The Four Innovative Methods in This Section

blocks.zh: TR86 Section 5 介紹業界正在採用的四項創新技術：
blocks.en: TR86 Section 5 introduces four innovative technologies being adopted by industry:

blocks.zh: 氦氣測試（Helium Testing）：決定性、非破壞性CCIT，適用於SUS袋
blocks.en: Helium testing: a deterministic, nondestructive CCIT suited to SUS bags

blocks.zh: 光學發射光譜（OES）：利用頭空氣體特徵光譜偵測洩漏
blocks.en: Optical emission spectroscopy (OES): detects leaks using the characteristic spectra of headspace gases

blocks.zh: 空氣超音波（Airborne Ultrasound）：密封完整性測試，適用多孔性包裝
blocks.en: Airborne ultrasound: seal integrity testing for porous packaging

blocks.zh: X射線偵測（X-Ray）：支援性CCI評估工具，用於玻璃缺陷/器械內部檢測
blocks.en: X-ray detection: a supporting CCI assessment tool for glass defects and the internal inspection of devices

blocks.zh: 重要提醒
blocks.en: Important reminder

blocks.zh: PDA明確指出，即使是「創新方法」，也仍有其限制與挑戰。這是選擇方法時的核心認識——沒有完美的單一技術。
blocks.en: PDA states explicitly that even these "innovative methods" have limitations and challenges. This is a core point when selecting a method: no single technology is perfect.

blocks.zh: CDMO視角
blocks.en: CDMO perspective

blocks.zh: 對於接受多客戶委託的CDMO而言，這四種方法分別對應不同的產品類型與包裝格式。理解各方法的適用範圍，能讓你在客戶技術審查或法規查核中快速對答如流。
blocks.en: A CDMO serving many clients will meet all four methods, each matched to a different product type and package format. Knowing the scope of each method lets you answer confidently during client technical reviews or regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: Helium Testing 氦氣測試
blocks.en: Helium Testing

blocks.zh: 氦氣測試基本定義
blocks.en: Basic Definition of Helium Testing

blocks.zh: 決定性（Deterministic）：測試結果有科學根據，非機率性
blocks.en: Deterministic: results have a scientific basis and are not probabilistic

blocks.zh: 非破壞性（Nondestructive）：測試後產品可繼續使用
blocks.en: Nondestructive: the product can still be used after testing

blocks.zh: 原本用途：剛性容器（如金屬或硬質容器）
blocks.en: Original use: rigid containers (such as metal or hard-walled containers)

blocks.zh: 現在擴展到：軟性高分子容器系統（如SUS袋）
blocks.en: Now extended to: flexible polymer container systems (such as SUS bags)

blocks.zh: 5.1.1 Application — 應用
blocks.en: 5.1.1 Application

blocks.zh: 適用條件
blocks.en: Applicability conditions

blocks.zh: 測試品必須是乾燥的
blocks.en: The test article must be dry

blocks.zh: 需能承受至少 1 psi 壓差
blocks.en: It must withstand a pressure differential of at least 1 psi

blocks.zh: 適用2-D及3-D SUS袋（包括生物反應器袋、混合袋、儲液袋）
blocks.en: Suitable for 2-D and 3-D SUS bags (including bioreactor bags, mixing bags and storage bags)

blocks.zh: 可測試複雜管路歧管系統（100個以上接點）
blocks.en: Can test complex tubing manifold systems (100 or more connections)

blocks.zh: 有天然洩漏率超過限值的元件（如帶多孔膜的無菌連接器）必須排除在外
blocks.en: Components whose natural leak rate exceeds the limit (such as sterile connectors with porous membranes) must be excluded

blocks.zh: 流程比喻：潛水艇加壓測試
blocks.en: Process analogy: submarine pressure test

blocks.zh: 想像把SUS袋放進密封艙室，先抽真空（讓外部壓力降低），再把氦氣充進袋子裡。如果袋子有洞，氦氣就會跑進艙室的真空環境，被質譜儀偵測到。就像潛水艇加壓測試一樣——哪裡漏氣，儀器就知道。
blocks.en: Imagine placing a SUS bag in a sealed chamber, pulling a vacuum (lowering the external pressure), and then filling the bag with helium. If the bag has a hole, helium escapes into the vacuum environment of the chamber and is picked up by the mass spectrometer. Like a submarine pressure test, wherever gas leaks out, the instrument knows.

blocks.zh:
流程示意圖（文字版）：

[SUS袋組裝體]
      |
      v
放入密封測試艙室
      |
      v
抽真空（降低外部壓力）
      |
      v
充入氦氣至袋內
      |
      v
保持固定時間
      |
      v
質譜儀偵測洩漏氦氣
      |
   ┌──┴──┐
   |       |
PASS    FAIL
（無洩漏）（偵測到洩漏）
blocks.en:
Process diagram (text version):

[SUS bag assembly]
      |
      v
Place in sealed test chamber
      |
      v
Pull vacuum (lower external pressure)
      |
      v
Fill bag with helium
      |
      v
Hold for a set time
      |
      v
Mass spectrometer detects leaking helium
      |
   ┌──┴──┐
   |       |
PASS    FAIL
(no leak)(leak detected)

blocks.zh: 掩蔽效應（Masking Effect）
blocks.en: Masking Effect

blocks.zh: 若袋子在測試過程中因壓差而變形，可能蓋住缺陷位置，導致偽陰性。解決方式：在測試艙中安裝約束板與多孔間隔片，讓袋子在機械支撐下維持形狀。
blocks.en: If the bag deforms under the pressure differential during testing, it can cover the defect location and cause a false negative. The solution is to install constraint plates and porous spacers in the test chamber so the bag keeps its shape under mechanical support.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務重點
blocks.en: Practical points for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 生技製藥廠的SUS袋管路（manifold）系統往往有數十個接點——barb-tube、film-film、film-fitment。氦氣測試是唯一能一次對整套系統做決定性完整性驗證的方法，適合作為放行（release）測試的一部分。
blocks.en: The SUS bag manifold systems in biopharma plants often have dozens of connections: barb-tube, film-film and film-fitment. Helium testing is the only method that can give a deterministic integrity verification of the entire system in one test, which makes it suitable as part of release testing.

blocks.zh: 5.1.2 Test Equipment and Parameters — 測試設備與參數
blocks.en: 5.1.2 Test Equipment and Parameters

blocks.zh: 關鍵設備元件
blocks.en: Key equipment components

blocks.zh: 真空測試艙室：容納測試品並維持真空環境
blocks.en: Vacuum test chamber: holds the test article and maintains the vacuum environment

blocks.zh: 壓力感測器：監控艙室壓力，及早發現總洩漏
blocks.en: Pressure sensor: monitors chamber pressure to catch gross leaks early

blocks.zh: 真空泵：抽空艙室環境
blocks.en: Vacuum pump: evacuates the chamber environment

blocks.zh: 質譜儀（Mass Spectrometer）：高靈敏度偵測氦氣分子
blocks.en: Mass spectrometer: detects helium molecules with high sensitivity

blocks.zh: 雙管路系統：一條抽真空兼攜帶氦氣去偵測器；一條充氦氣進入袋子
blocks.en: Dual-line system: one line evacuates the chamber and carries helium to the detector; the other fills the bag with helium

blocks.zh: 影響測試結果的關鍵參數（Critical Parameters）
blocks.en: Critical Parameters affecting test results

blocks.zh: 缺陷尺寸（Defect Size）
blocks.en: Defect size

blocks.zh: SUS袋壁的氦氣透過率（He Permeability）
blocks.en: Helium permeability of the SUS bag wall

blocks.zh: 測試壓力（Test Pressure）
blocks.en: Test pressure

blocks.zh: 測試溫度（Test Temperature）
blocks.en: Test temperature

blocks.zh: 袋體及管路表面積（Surface Area）
blocks.en: Surface area of the bag and tubing

blocks.zh: 氦氣注入量（He Injection Volume）
blocks.en: Helium injection volume

blocks.zh: 測試時間（Test Time / Collection Time）
blocks.en: Test time / collection time

blocks.zh: 所有參數必須透過收集正常袋（nondefective）與缺陷袋（defective）的對比數據來決定，以最大化兩者差距為目標。
blocks.en: All parameters must be determined by comparing data collected from nondefective and defective bags, with the goal of maximizing the separation between the two.

blocks.zh: 5.1.3 Leak Detection Limit — 洩漏偵測極限
blocks.en: 5.1.3 Leak Detection Limit

blocks.zh: 偵測範圍
blocks.en: Detection range

blocks.zh: 氦氣測試的偵測範圍：10-8 至 10-4 atm·mbar·L/s
blocks.en: Detection range of helium testing: 10-8 to 10-4 atm·mbar·L/s

blocks.zh: 能偵測到直徑 2 µm 的雷射鑽孔缺陷（2微米針孔等效流徑）
blocks.en: Can detect laser-drilled defects with a diameter of 2 µm (equivalent flow path of a 2 µm pinhole)

blocks.zh: 靈敏度的關鍵概念
blocks.en: Key concept for sensitivity

blocks.zh: 真正決定方法靈敏度的不是儀器本身的最小偵測量，而是：
blocks.en: What really determines the sensitivity of the method is not the instrument's minimum detectable quantity but:

blocks.zh: 有缺陷袋的洩漏率 − 無缺陷袋的背景洩漏率 = 信噪比（S/N）
blocks.en: Leak rate of a defective bag − background leak rate of a nondefective bag = signal-to-noise ratio (S/N)

blocks.zh: 背景洩漏率（background leak rate）受以下因素影響：
blocks.en: The background leak rate is affected by:

blocks.zh: 接點數量（越多，背景越高）
blocks.en: Number of connections (more connections, higher background)

blocks.zh: 袋膜表面積（越大，氦氣滲透越多）
blocks.en: Bag film surface area (larger area, more helium permeation)

blocks.zh: 膜材與管路材質的氦氣透過率
blocks.en: Helium permeability of the film and tubing materials

blocks.zh: 驗證策略含義
blocks.en: Implications for validation strategy

blocks.zh: 每種SUS袋設計都必須建立個別的接受標準（acceptance limit），並以足夠統計數量的陽性控制（positive controls，含已知缺陷）及陰性控制（negative controls）來支持。這是無法跨產品直接套用的。
blocks.en: Each SUS bag design must have its own acceptance limit, supported by a statistically sufficient number of positive controls (with known defects) and negative controls. This cannot be applied directly from one product to another.

blocks.zh: 5.1.4 Considerations and Challenges — 注意事項與挑戰
blocks.en: 5.1.4 Considerations and Challenges

blocks.zh: 五大注意事項
blocks.en: Five key considerations

blocks.zh: 儀器效能驗證：使用標準校準氦氣洩漏件（calibrated helium leaks）驗證儀器狀態
blocks.en: Instrument performance verification: use calibrated helium leaks to verify instrument status

blocks.zh: 定量洩漏率：氦氣測試給出的是定量數值，不只是通過/不通過
blocks.en: Quantitative leak rate: helium testing gives a quantitative value, not just pass/fail

blocks.zh: 多重缺陷：可偵測多個缺陷的存在，但無法定位缺陷位置
blocks.en: Multiple defects: it can detect the presence of multiple defects but cannot locate them

blocks.zh: 高透氦材質問題：若袋膜對氦氣透過性很高，靈敏度會大幅下降
blocks.en: Highly helium-permeable materials: if the bag film is highly permeable to helium, sensitivity drops significantly

blocks.zh: 偽陽性控制：在儀器中加裝內建洩漏件（in-line leak），確保每次測試循環中感測器正常運作，降低偽陽性風險
blocks.en: False-positive control: fit an in-line leak in the instrument to confirm the sensor is working in every test cycle, reducing the risk of false positives

blocks.zh: 比喻：不能定位但能確認
blocks.en: Analogy: it confirms, but cannot locate

blocks.zh: 氦氣測試就像你知道房間裡有人在說話，但不知道是哪個人在說。它能確認「有洩漏」以及洩漏量，但要找到洩漏位置，還需要其他輔助方法（如視覺檢測或分段測試）。
blocks.en: Helium testing is like knowing someone in the room is talking without knowing who. It can confirm that "there is a leak" and how large it is, but finding the leak location needs other methods (such as visual inspection or segmented testing).

blocks.zh: Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES) 光學發射光譜
blocks.en: Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES)

blocks.zh: OES 基本物理原理
blocks.en: Basic Physics of OES

blocks.zh: 每種化學元素在激發後發出的電磁輻射頻率是獨一無二的，就像「元素的指紋」。OES利用這個特性，在真空環境中分析從容器洩漏出來的氣體成分。
blocks.en: Each chemical element emits electromagnetic radiation at a unique frequency after excitation, like an "elemental fingerprint". OES uses this property to analyze the composition of gas leaking out of a container in a vacuum environment.

blocks.zh: 比喻：燃燒火焰顏色
blocks.en: Analogy: flame colors

blocks.zh: 不同金屬燃燒會發出不同顏色的火焰（鈉=黃、銅=綠、鉀=紫）。OES原理相同——用特定波長的光譜線來識別是哪種氣體在洩漏。
blocks.en: Different metals burn with different flame colors (sodium = yellow, copper = green, potassium = violet). OES works on the same principle, using spectral lines at specific wavelengths to identify which gas is leaking.

blocks.zh: OES最大優勢
blocks.en: The biggest advantage of OES

blocks.zh: 不需要預先充入示蹤氣體！直接利用容器頭空間中原本就有的氣體（N2、CO2、O2、水蒸氣）作為偵測標記。這讓OES比傳統示蹤氣體方法更適合直接應用於已封裝的成品。
blocks.en: No tracer gas needs to be filled in beforehand! It uses the gases already present in the container headspace (N2, CO2, O2, water vapor) as detection markers. This makes OES better suited than traditional tracer gas methods for direct application to finished, sealed products.

blocks.zh: 5.2.1 Application — 應用
blocks.en: 5.2.1 Application

blocks.zh: 適用包裝類型
blocks.en: Applicable package types

blocks.zh: 小袋（Pouches）
blocks.en: Pouches

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶（Vials）
blocks.en: Vials

blocks.zh: 預充注射器（Prefilled Syringes）
blocks.en: Prefilled syringes

blocks.zh: 卡匣（Cartridges）
blocks.en: Cartridges

blocks.zh: 分子特徵的雙重價值
blocks.en: Dual value of the molecular signature

blocks.zh:
用途1：定位洩漏來源
CO2充填液體包裝 → CO2升高 = 頭空間洩漏
blocks.en:
Use 1: locating the leak source
CO2-filled liquid package: elevated CO2 = headspace leak

blocks.zh:
用途2：降低偽陽性
氮氣充填乾燥產品 → 氫氣異常升高 = 艙室密封洩漏（不是產品洩漏）→ 避免誤判
blocks.en:
Use 2: reducing false positives
Nitrogen-filled dry product: abnormally elevated hydrogen = chamber seal leak (not a product leak), which avoids a misjudgment

blocks.zh: 玻璃產品的批次測試優勢
blocks.en: Batch testing advantage for glass products

blocks.zh: 玻璃的外氣率（outgassing rate）極低，因此多支注射器可以同時放入艙室批次測試，提升生產效率，同時維持高靈敏度。這對大批量注射劑生產線特別有價值。
blocks.en: Glass has a very low outgassing rate, so multiple syringes can be placed in the chamber at once for batch testing, improving productivity while maintaining high sensitivity. This is especially valuable for high-volume injectable production lines.

blocks.zh: 5.2.2 Test Equipment and Parameters — 設備與參數
blocks.en: 5.2.2 Test Equipment and Parameters

blocks.zh: OES 測試三步驟
blocks.en: Three steps of OES testing

blocks.zh:
步驟1：粗抽真空（Rough Evacuation）
從大氣壓抽到幾mbar
→ 若有嚴重洩漏，無法達到目標真空
→ 測試中止，顯示錯誤

步驟2：高真空抽氣（High-Vacuum Evacuation）
壓力降至 < 5×10⁻² mbar
→ OES感測器開始與艙室接觸
→ 等待1-2秒壓力穩定

步驟3：測量（Measurement）
OES感測器持續測量
→ 激發等離子體（plasma）
→ 相機捕獲特徵光譜線
→ 分析波長與強度（amplitude）
→ 強度隨時間變化 ∝ 洩漏率
blocks.en:
Step 1: Rough Evacuation
Pump down from atmospheric pressure to a few mbar
→ If there is a gross leak, the target vacuum cannot be reached
→ Test aborts and displays an error

Step 2: High-Vacuum Evacuation
Pressure drops to < 5×10⁻² mbar
→ The OES sensor starts to communicate with the chamber
→ Wait 1-2 seconds for pressure to stabilize

Step 3: Measurement
The OES sensor measures continuously
→ Excites a plasma
→ A camera captures the characteristic spectral lines
→ Analyzes wavelength and intensity (amplitude)
→ Intensity change over time ∝ leak rate

blocks.zh: 關鍵物理關係
blocks.en: Key physical relationships

blocks.zh: 發射強度（emission intensity）∝ 氣體混合物中該元素的分壓（partial pressure）
blocks.en: Emission intensity ∝ partial pressure of that element in the gas mixture

blocks.zh: 強度隨時間的變化率 ∝ 洩漏率 + 外氣率（outgassing）
blocks.en: The rate of change of intensity over time ∝ leak rate + outgassing

blocks.zh: 測試時間由所需LOD與材料外氣率共同決定
blocks.en: Test time is determined jointly by the required LOD and the outgassing rate of the material

blocks.zh: 校準要求
blocks.en: Calibration requirements

blocks.zh: 設備必須配備認證校準洩漏件（certified calibrated leak），校準程序包含：
blocks.en: The equipment must be fitted with a certified calibrated leak, and the calibration procedure includes:

blocks.zh: 陰性樣品（negative sample）
blocks.en: A negative sample

blocks.zh: 含適當氣體的校準洩漏件
blocks.en: A calibrated leak containing the appropriate gas

blocks.zh: 每種新產品都需要重新進行初始校準（initial set-up calibration）。
blocks.en: An initial set-up calibration is required again for each new product.

blocks.zh: 5.2.3 Leak Detection Limit — 洩漏偵測極限
blocks.en: 5.2.3 Leak Detection Limit

blocks.zh: LOD的決定因素
blocks.en: Factors determining the LOD

blocks.zh: OES的靈敏度（LOD）由容器材料的外氣率（outgassing rate）決定，而非儀器本身的限制。外氣率越低，背景雜訊越小，能偵測的洩漏越小。
blocks.en: The sensitivity (LOD) of OES is determined by the outgassing rate of the container material, not by the limits of the instrument itself. The lower the outgassing rate, the lower the background noise and the smaller the leak that can be detected.

blocks.zh: 含液體洩漏的特殊效應
blocks.en: Special effect of liquid in the leak

blocks.zh: 在高真空條件下，水只以蒸氣形式存在。當洩漏通道中有液體時：
blocks.en: Under high-vacuum conditions, water exists only as vapor. When there is liquid in the leak path:

blocks.zh: 液態水不斷蒸發 → 持續產生大量水蒸氣
blocks.en: Liquid water keeps evaporating, continuously generating a large amount of water vapor

blocks.zh: 通過洩漏的氣體量遠高於乾燥洩漏
blocks.en: The amount of gas passing through the leak is much higher than for a dry leak

blocks.zh: LOD向更小的孔洞尺寸偏移（更靈敏）
blocks.en: The LOD shifts toward smaller hole sizes (more sensitive)

blocks.zh: 因此，對於含液體的預充注射器或液態藥品，OES的靈敏度比對乾燥產品更高。
blocks.en: Therefore, for prefilled syringes or liquid drug products, OES is more sensitive than it is for dry products.

blocks.zh: 風險：大洩漏反而通過測試
blocks.en: Risk: a large leak can pass the test

blocks.zh: 若洩漏非常大，在抽真空階段所有氣體和水蒸氣就已被抽出，到了測量步驟時容器已空，OES無法偵測到任何訊號差異 → 偽陰性（false-negative = leaker passes as intact）
blocks.en: If the leak is very large, all the gas and water vapor are already pumped out during the evacuation stage, and by the measurement step the container is empty, so OES detects no difference in signal → false negative (the leaker passes as intact)

blocks.zh: 建議：選用此方法前評估此風險，必要時配合視覺檢查（檢查空容器或變形容器）。
blocks.en: Recommendation: evaluate this risk before choosing this method and, where necessary, add visual inspection (to check for empty or deformed containers).

blocks.zh: 5.2.4 Considerations and Challenges — 注意事項與挑戰
blocks.en: 5.2.4 Considerations and Challenges

blocks.zh: 四大挑戰與考量
blocks.en: Four main challenges and considerations

blocks.zh: 安全性：處理毒性藥物時，若有大洩漏，操作人員暴露風險升高，需遵守當地安全法規
blocks.en: Safety: when handling toxic drugs, a large leak raises the exposure risk for operators, so local safety regulations must be followed

blocks.zh: 艙室設計：需設計防液體溢出功能，並最小化測試體積
blocks.en: Chamber design: needs liquid-spill protection and a minimized test volume

blocks.zh: 大分子藥物：高真空下，大分子可能堵塞洩漏通道，影響偵測 → 必須針對特定藥物進行方法確效
blocks.en: Large-molecule drugs: under high vacuum, large molecules may block the leak path and affect detection, so the method must be validated for the specific drug

blocks.zh: 彈性包裝/活動部件：預充注射器活塞可能在真空下移動並損壞包裝，艙室必須有適當約束設計
blocks.en: Flexible packaging / moving parts: the plunger of a prefilled syringe may move under vacuum and damage the package, so the chamber must have an appropriate restraint design

blocks.zh: CDMO選用OES的關鍵判斷
blocks.en: Key judgment for a CDMO choosing OES

blocks.zh: OES對玻璃容器（瓶、注射器）最理想，因為玻璃外氣率低。若客戶產品是IV袋或其他高外氣率材質，需先評估是否會干擾測試結果。每更換一個藥品配方，都需要重新確效。
blocks.en: OES is ideal for glass containers (vials, syringes) because glass has a low outgassing rate. If the client's product is an IV bag or another high-outgassing material, first evaluate whether it will interfere with the test results. Every change of drug formulation requires revalidation.

blocks.zh: Airborne Ultrasound 空氣超音波
blocks.en: Airborne Ultrasound

blocks.zh: 超音波物理基礎
blocks.en: Basic Physics of Ultrasound

blocks.zh: 超音波是高頻聲波，在兩種聲阻抗（acoustic impedance）不同的介質交界面，會發生：
blocks.en: Ultrasound is a high-frequency sound wave. At the interface between two media with different acoustic impedance, the following occur:

blocks.zh: 部分反射（reflection）
blocks.en: Partial reflection

blocks.zh: 部分穿透（transmission）
blocks.en: Partial transmission

blocks.zh: 折射（refraction）
blocks.en: Refraction

blocks.zh: 吸收（absorption）
blocks.en: Absorption

blocks.zh: 繞射（diffraction）
blocks.en: Diffraction

blocks.zh: 空氣超音波為點焦式訊號，每秒脈衝500次。
blocks.en: Airborne ultrasound is a point-focused signal pulsed 500 times per second.

blocks.zh: 5.3.1 Application — 應用
blocks.en: 5.3.1 Application

blocks.zh: 為何多孔包裝需要超音波？
blocks.en: Why do porous packages need ultrasound?

blocks.zh: 多孔性無菌屏障包裝（如Tyvek袋）允許氣體通過以維持無菌屏障，但這同時意味著：
blocks.en: Porous sterile barrier packaging (such as Tyvek pouches) lets gas pass through to maintain the sterile barrier, but this also means:

blocks.zh: 真空衰減法 → 無法用（氣體會穿透膜材）
blocks.en: Vacuum decay: cannot be used (gas permeates the membrane material)

blocks.zh: 示蹤氣體法 → 無法用（示蹤氣體會從膜材本體逸出）
blocks.en: Tracer gas methods: cannot be used (tracer gas escapes through the bulk of the membrane)

blocks.zh: 空氣超音波 → 可以用（偵測密封區的物理黏合品質，非氣體洩漏）
blocks.en: Airborne ultrasound: can be used (it detects the physical bonding quality of the seal area, not gas leakage)

blocks.zh: 視覺檢查的盲點
blocks.en: The blind spot of visual inspection

blocks.zh: 外觀良好的密封不等於完整密封！熱封條（heat-sealing bar）可能在袋子外表留下完美的熱封痕跡，但內層實際上沒有完全黏合——這種「外好內壞」的密封只能用超音波偵測到。
blocks.en: A good-looking seal is not necessarily an intact seal! A heat-sealing bar can leave a perfect seal mark on the outside of the pouch while the inner layers are not fully bonded. This kind of seal, good outside and bad inside, can only be detected by ultrasound.

blocks.zh: 主要應用場景
blocks.en: Main application scenarios

blocks.zh: 線上生產檢測（online inspection，封口後立即掃描）
blocks.en: Online inspection (scanning immediately after sealing)

blocks.zh: Tyvek無菌袋密封品質驗證
blocks.en: Seal quality verification of Tyvek sterile pouches

blocks.zh: 軟性屏障包裝的密封強度篩查
blocks.en: Seal strength screening of flexible barrier packaging

blocks.zh: 5.3.2 Test Equipment and Parameters — 設備與參數
blocks.en: 5.3.2 Test Equipment and Parameters

blocks.zh: 雙層隔音窗比喻
blocks.en: Analogy: double-glazed soundproof window

blocks.zh:
良好密封（bonded seal）= 單層玻璃窗
  → 超音波順利穿透
  → 接收端訊號強度高
  → PASS

密封不良或無密封 = 雙層隔音窗
  → 超音波大部分被反射/吸收
  → 接收端訊號強度低
  → FAIL

有切割/孔洞
  → 超音波繞過密封直接穿過
  → 接收端訊號異常高峰
  → FAIL
blocks.en:
Good seal (bonded seal) = single-pane window
  → Ultrasound passes through easily
  → High signal intensity at the receiver
  → PASS

Poor seal or no seal = double-glazed soundproof window
  → Most of the ultrasound is reflected/absorbed
  → Low signal intensity at the receiver
  → FAIL

Cut/hole
  → Ultrasound bypasses the seal and passes straight through
  → Abnormally high signal peak at the receiver
  → FAIL

blocks.zh: 兩種數據呈現方式
blocks.en: Two ways of presenting data

blocks.zh: 線性掃描（Linear Scan）
blocks.en: Linear Scan

blocks.zh: 結果呈折線圖（訊號強度 vs 位置）
blocks.en: Result shown as a line graph (signal intensity vs. position)

blocks.zh: 最適合離散缺陷偵測
blocks.en: Best suited to discrete defect detection

blocks.zh: 統計摘要：平均值、最大值、最小值、標準差、掃描長度
blocks.en: Statistical summary: mean, maximum, minimum, standard deviation, scan length

blocks.zh: 複合掃描（Composite Scan / Optoacoustic Image）
blocks.en: Composite Scan / Optoacoustic Image

blocks.zh: 多條線性掃描組合成2D聲學影像
blocks.en: Multiple linear scans combined into a 2D acoustic image

blocks.zh: 以bitmap格式呈現（本質上是定量的）
blocks.en: Presented in bitmap format (quantitative in nature)

blocks.zh: 更適合整體密封品質評估與視覺化
blocks.en: Better suited to overall seal quality assessment and visualization

blocks.zh: 接受標準（Acceptance Limits）
blocks.en: Acceptance Limits

blocks.zh: 系統使用統計摘要數據來判定通過/不通過。若任何統計值超出接受限值 → 判定失敗。所有統計值均在限值內 → 判定通過。
blocks.en: The system uses the statistical summary data to determine pass/fail. If any statistical value falls outside its acceptance limit, the result is a fail. If all statistical values are within their limits, the result is a pass.

blocks.zh: 5.3.3 Leak Detection Limit — 洩漏偵測極限
blocks.en: 5.3.3 Leak Detection Limit

blocks.zh: 可偵測的缺陷類型
blocks.en: Detectable defect types

blocks.zh: 冷封（Cold Seals）：熱封溫度不足，未達黏合溫度
blocks.en: Cold Seals: sealing temperature too low to reach the bonding temperature

blocks.zh: 通道缺陷（Channel Defects）：密封中有連通外部的通道
blocks.en: Channel Defects: a channel in the seal connects to the outside

blocks.zh: 皺褶（Wrinkles）：膜材皺摺導致密封不均
blocks.en: Wrinkles: film creases cause an uneven seal

blocks.zh: 未黏合區域（Non-bonding）：部分區域未完成密封
blocks.en: Non-bonding: areas where sealing was not completed

blocks.zh: 材質變異（Material Variations）：膜材密度或厚度不均
blocks.en: Material Variations: uneven film density or thickness

blocks.zh: 切割/孔洞（Cuts/Holes）：密封區的物理破損
blocks.en: Cuts/Holes: physical damage in the seal area

blocks.zh: 偵測能力主要取決於超音波物理特性和材料特性。
blocks.en: Detection capability depends mainly on the physical properties of ultrasound and the material properties.

blocks.zh: 5.3.4 Considerations and Challenges — 注意事項與挑戰
blocks.en: 5.3.4 Considerations and Challenges

blocks.zh: 兩大挑戰
blocks.en: Two main challenges

blocks.zh: 1. 液體夾帶（Product Inclusion）
blocks.en: 1. Product Inclusion

blocks.zh: 若產品液體被夾入密封區內（常見的密封缺陷原因），液體能有效傳導超音波訊號——即使密封不完整，訊號也可能看起來像良好密封 → 偽陰性風險
blocks.en: If product liquid is trapped in the seal area (a common cause of seal defects), the liquid conducts the ultrasound signal effectively, so even when the seal is incomplete the signal may look like a good seal → risk of false negatives

blocks.zh: 2. 密封幾何形狀（Seal Geometry）
blocks.en: 2. Seal Geometry

blocks.zh: 感測器必須在袋子邊緣內側2-3 mm以上的範圍掃描，才能產生有效訊號。靠近邊緣時，音波會繞過密封邊緣直接到達接收端，干擾判讀。
blocks.en: The sensor must scan at least 2-3 mm inside the edge of the pouch to produce a valid signal. Close to the edge, sound waves go around the seal edge and reach the receiver directly, interfering with interpretation.

blocks.zh: 比喻：水中傳音
blocks.en: Analogy: sound traveling through water

blocks.zh: 水的聲阻抗比空氣低得多，聲音在水中傳播比在空氣中容易。如果缺陷通道中充滿液體，超音波就像在水中傳播一樣順暢通過——儀器誤以為密封完整。這就是為什麼超音波對液體夾帶的密封缺陷有盲點。
blocks.en: The acoustic impedance of water is much lower than that of air, so sound travels more easily in water than in air. If the defect channel is filled with liquid, ultrasound passes through as smoothly as it would through water, and the instrument wrongly concludes that the seal is intact. This is why ultrasound has a blind spot for seal defects with liquid inclusion.

blocks.zh: X-Ray Detection X射線偵測
blocks.en: X-Ray Detection

blocks.zh: 重要定位：X射線不是洩漏測試
blocks.en: Key positioning: X-ray is not a leak test

blocks.zh: X射線偵測既不定量也不定性地評估洩漏率，它是支援性CCI評估工具，用來識別可能導致洩漏的物理缺陷（如玻璃裂縫、塞子配合不佳），而非直接量測洩漏。
blocks.en: X-ray detection evaluates leak rate neither quantitatively nor qualitatively. It is a supporting CCI assessment tool used to identify physical defects that may lead to leakage (such as glass cracks or poor stopper fit), not to measure leakage directly.

blocks.zh: 實務上通常與真正的洩漏測試（如氦氣測試）配合使用。
blocks.en: In practice it is usually used together with a true leak test (such as helium testing).

blocks.zh: X射線物理特性
blocks.en: Physical Properties of X-Rays
Wavelength: 0.01–10 nm

blocks.zh: 頻率：30 PHz–30 EHz
blocks.en: Frequency: 30 PHz–30 EHz

blocks.zh: 能量：100 eV–100 keV
blocks.en: Energy: 100 eV–100 keV

blocks.zh: 波長比UV短，比gamma射線長
blocks.en: Shorter wavelength than UV, longer than gamma rays

blocks.zh: 產生方式：X射線管（高壓加速電子轟擊金屬陽極）
blocks.en: Generation: X-ray tube (high-voltage accelerated electrons bombarding a metal anode)

blocks.zh: 5.4.1 Application — 應用
blocks.en: 5.4.1 Application

blocks.zh: X射線的應用定位
blocks.en: Where X-ray fits

blocks.zh: X射線能偵測肉眼或一般視覺系統看不到的物理屬性缺陷：
blocks.en: X-ray can detect physical defects that the naked eye or standard vision systems cannot see:

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶/注射器裂縫（glass cracks）
blocks.en: Cracks in glass vials/syringes (glass cracks)

blocks.zh: 塞子配合不佳（poor stopper fit）
blocks.en: Poor stopper fit

blocks.zh: 鋁蓋下方的玻璃缺陷（defects under crimp）
blocks.en: Glass defects under the aluminum cap (defects under crimp)

blocks.zh: 組裝器械內部的功能缺陷
blocks.en: Functional defects inside assembled devices

blocks.zh: 注意：X射線能顯示缺陷「存在」，但不能證明氣體或液體實際會從該缺陷洩漏。
blocks.en: Note: X-ray can show that a defect exists, but it cannot prove that gas or liquid would actually leak through that defect.

blocks.zh: 5.4.2 Test Equipment and Parameters — 設備與參數
blocks.en: 5.4.2 Test Equipment and Parameters

blocks.zh: X射線管類型
blocks.en: X-ray tube types

blocks.zh: 密封管（Closed-tube）：焦點 800–1500 µm，一般用途
blocks.en: Closed-tube: focal spot 800–1500 µm, general purpose

blocks.zh: 微焦管（Microfocus tube）：焦點 1–5 µm，CCI評估最佳選擇
blocks.en: Microfocus tube: focal spot 1–5 µm, the best choice for CCI assessment

blocks.zh: 焦點越小 → 空間解析度越高 → 能看到越細微的缺陷
blocks.en: Smaller focal spot → higher spatial resolution → finer defects can be seen

blocks.zh: 5.4.3 Leak Detection — 洩漏偵測
blocks.en: 5.4.3 Leak Detection

blocks.zh: X射線能偵測的玻璃/器械缺陷
blocks.en: Glass/device defects X-ray can detect

blocks.zh: 注射器筒身大裂縫（syringe barrel cracks）
blocks.en: Large cracks in the syringe barrel (syringe barrel cracks)

blocks.zh: 瓶口鋁蓋下方的玻璃缺陷（glass defects under crimp）
blocks.en: Glass defects under the crimp cap at the vial neck (glass defects under crimp)

blocks.zh: 安瓿頸部玻璃切割缺陷
blocks.en: Glass cutting defects at the ampoule neck

blocks.zh: 針座黏膠缺陷（needle socket gluing imperfections）
blocks.en: Needle socket gluing imperfections

blocks.zh: 注射器Luer lock缺陷
blocks.en: Syringe Luer lock defects

blocks.zh: 針護罩內的彎針/截斷針頭
blocks.en: Bent or broken needles inside the needle shield

blocks.zh: 鋁蓋穿透的特殊優勢
blocks.en: Special advantage of penetrating aluminum

blocks.zh: X射線能輕易穿透鋁材，因此可以：
blocks.en: X-rays penetrate aluminum easily, so it is possible to:

blocks.zh: 看穿西林瓶鋁軋蓋，檢查瓶口的玻璃缺陷
blocks.en: See through the aluminum crimp cap of a vial to check for glass defects at the neck

blocks.zh: 在不拆包裝的情況下，檢查吸塑包裝（blister）或二次包裝內的器械
blocks.en: Inspect devices inside blister packs or secondary packaging without opening the package

blocks.zh: 自動化裂縫偵測需要最少6個角度的掃描，以避免裂縫方向導致的偽陰性。
blocks.en: Automated crack detection requires scans from at least 6 angles to avoid false negatives caused by crack orientation.

blocks.zh: 調查工具的價值
blocks.en: Value as an investigation tool

blocks.zh: 當已知某批次有洩漏問題時，X射線CT掃描是最有價值的調查工具——能在不破壞樣品的情況下，3D可視化洩漏源的物理原因（如塞子壓縮量、密封幾何形狀）。
blocks.en: When a batch is known to have a leak problem, X-ray CT scanning is the most valuable investigation tool. Without destroying the sample, it visualizes the physical cause of the leak source in 3D (such as stopper compression and seal geometry).

blocks.zh: 5.4.4 Considerations and Challenges — 注意事項與挑戰
blocks.en: 5.4.4 Considerations and Challenges

blocks.zh: 包裝開發階段的X射線應用
blocks.en: X-ray applications during package development

blocks.zh: 包材選擇：評估不同塞子的壓縮量與配合情況
blocks.en: Packaging material selection: evaluate stopper compression and fit for different stoppers

blocks.zh: 組裝參數優化：軋蓋（capping）設定對塞子壓縮的影響
blocks.en: Assembly parameter optimization: effect of capping settings on stopper compression

blocks.zh: 冷凍儲存影響：塞子因達到玻璃轉化溫度（Tg）而收縮，CT掃描可定量表徵此效應
blocks.en: Effect of frozen storage: stoppers shrink as they pass the glass transition temperature (Tg), and CT scanning can characterize this effect quantitatively

blocks.zh: 塞子凹陷（Dimpling）評估：不同彈性體的幾何形狀比較
blocks.en: Stopper dimpling assessment: compare the geometry of different elastomers

blocks.zh: 文獻案例
blocks.en: Literature examples

blocks.zh: Mathaes et al. (2016)：軋蓋優化研究——CT掃描計算塞子壓縮量並可視化密封幾何，與氦氣洩漏測試結果相互驗證。
blocks.en: Mathaes et al. (2016): a capping optimization study in which CT scanning calculated stopper compression and visualized seal geometry, cross-verified against helium leak test results.

blocks.zh: Nieto et al. (2016)：冷凍儲存條件下，CT掃描解釋兩組塞子洩漏測試結果差異——發現翻蓋（flip-off cap）與彈性體之間有間隙，以及land seal外緣問題。
blocks.en: Nieto et al. (2016): under frozen storage conditions, CT scanning explained the difference in leak test results between two sets of stoppers, revealing a gap between the flip-off cap and the elastomer and a problem at the outer edge of the land seal.

blocks.zh: CDMO開發階段的典型X射線工作流程
blocks.en: Typical X-ray workflow during CDMO development

blocks.zh:
1. 候選包材篩選（3-4種塞子）
        ↓
2. CT掃描 → 計算各塞子壓縮量
   + 可視化密封幾何
        ↓
3. 配合氦氣洩漏測試驗證完整性
        ↓
4. 評估冷凍/解凍循環後的塞子收縮
   （使用CT掃描量化）
        ↓
5. 選定最佳包材 + 確定軋蓋參數
blocks.en:
1. Screen candidate packaging materials (3-4 stoppers)
        ↓
2. CT scan → calculate compression of each stopper
   + visualize seal geometry
        ↓
3. Verify integrity with helium leak testing
        ↓
4. Evaluate stopper shrinkage after freeze/thaw cycles
   (quantified by CT scan)
        ↓
5. Select the best packaging + define capping parameters

blocks.zh: Summary Comparison Table — 四大創新方法綜合比較
blocks.en: Summary Comparison Table — Comparison of the Four Innovative Methods

blocks.zh: This table summarizes all four innovative methods covered in Section 5 for quick reference and exam review. 本表整合Section 5四種方法，供快速對照與複習。
blocks.en: This table summarizes all four innovative methods covered in Section 5 for quick reference and exam review.

blocks.zh: 方法選擇決策指引
blocks.en: Method Selection Decision Guide

blocks.zh: Section 5 核心記憶點 — Key Takeaways for Exam & Audit Readiness
blocks.en: Section 5 Key Takeaways for Exam & Audit Readiness

blocks.zh: 氦氣測試：決定性非破壞性；質譜儀偵測；能測整套組裝；無法定位缺陷位置。
blocks.en: Helium testing: deterministic and nondestructive; mass spectrometer detection; can test a whole assembly; cannot locate the defect.

blocks.zh: OES：不需示蹤氣體；用頭空間原有氣體；大洩漏有偽陰性風險；含液體時LOD更佳。
blocks.en: OES: no tracer gas needed; uses the gases already in the headspace; large leaks carry a false-negative risk; better LOD when liquid is present.

blocks.zh: 空氣超音波：多孔包裝唯一選擇；液體夾帶=偽陰性；密封邊緣2-3mm盲區。
blocks.en: Airborne ultrasound: the only option for porous packaging; liquid inclusion = false negative; blind zone of 2-3 mm at the seal edge.

blocks.zh: X射線：不是洩漏測試，是支援性工具；CT提供3D但很慢；面掃描快速；用於玻璃缺陷、器械內部及包裝開發。
blocks.en: X-ray: not a leak test but a supporting tool; CT gives 3D but is slow; area scans are fast; used for glass defects, device internals and package development.

blocks.zh: CDMO Validation Strategy & Regulatory Considerations — CDMO驗證策略與法規考量
blocks.en: CDMO Validation Strategy & Regulatory Considerations

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — CDMO驗證實務
blocks.en: Commentary — CDMO Validation in Practice

blocks.zh: 驗證套件必備要素
blocks.en: Essential elements of a validation package

blocks.zh: 靈敏度/LOD確立：使用已知缺陷尺寸的陽性控制樣品（如雷射鑽孔），建立最小可偵測缺陷
blocks.en: Establishing sensitivity/LOD: use positive control samples with known defect sizes (such as laser-drilled holes) to establish the minimum detectable defect

blocks.zh: 特異性：統計學上區分有缺陷與無缺陷樣品（偽陽性率與偽陰性率）
blocks.en: Specificity: statistically distinguish defective from nondefective samples (false-positive and false-negative rates)

blocks.zh: 重複性與再現性：同樣品多次測試，跨操作員/儀器確認一致性
blocks.en: Repeatability and reproducibility: test the same sample multiple times and confirm consistency across operators and instruments

blocks.zh: 穩健性：關鍵參數小幅變動對結果的影響評估
blocks.en: Robustness: evaluate the effect of small variations in critical parameters on the results

blocks.zh: 校準溯源性：所有參考洩漏件必須溯源至國家或國際標準
blocks.en: Calibration traceability: all reference leaks must be traceable to national or international standards

blocks.zh: 法規提交策略
blocks.en: Regulatory submission strategy

blocks.zh: 當CCIT方法寫入CMC（Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls）章節時，申請人需提供：
blocks.en: When a CCIT method is written into the CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls) section, the applicant needs to provide:

blocks.zh: 方法描述與原理
blocks.en: Method description and principle

blocks.zh: 驗證數據摘要（LOD、靈敏度、特異性）
blocks.en: Summary of validation data (LOD, sensitivity, specificity)

blocks.zh: 正控制（positive control）缺陷尺寸的科學依據
blocks.en: Scientific justification for the positive control defect size

blocks.zh: 日常監控計劃（ongoing monitoring）
blocks.en: Ongoing monitoring plan

blocks.zh: FDA與EMA對「確定性方法（deterministic methods）」有更強的偏好，這使得氦氣測試和OES在法規審查中具備優勢。
blocks.en: FDA and EMA show a stronger preference for deterministic methods, which gives helium testing and OES an advantage in regulatory review.

blocks.zh: 查廠常見問題 — 預備答案要點
blocks.en: Common Inspection Questions — Key Points for Prepared Answers

blocks.zh: 陽性控制缺陷尺寸選擇依據：通常基於微生物進入風險研究（microbial ingress studies）或文獻數據，確認該尺寸與無菌性風險相關
blocks.en: Rationale for the positive control defect size: usually based on microbial ingress studies or literature data, confirming that the size is relevant to sterility risk

blocks.zh: 背景洩漏率 vs. 缺陷訊號：需有統計數據顯示兩者間有足夠的分離度（signal separation）
blocks.en: Background leak rate vs. defect signal: statistical data are needed to show adequate separation between the two (signal separation)

blocks.zh: 儀器校準頻率：每次生產測試前應確認校準狀態，並有記錄
blocks.en: Instrument calibration frequency: calibration status should be confirmed and recorded before each production test

blocks.zh: 重新確效觸發條件：容器/密封元件變更、供應商更換、設備重大維修後
blocks.en: Revalidation triggers: container/closure component changes, supplier changes, and after major equipment repair

blocks.zh: OOS CCIT處理：需有書面OOS調查程序，明確定義何時隔離批次、何時進行額外測試
blocks.en: OOS CCIT handling: a written OOS investigation procedure is needed, clearly defining when to quarantine the batch and when to perform additional testing
